proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s Q A B _ _ hA hB
  have h1 : dist A Q = dist B Q := by
    rw [dist_comm A, dist_comm B]
    exact hA.dist_eq_of_mem_of_mem hB (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ Q A) (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ Q B)
  have h2 : dist s.center A = dist s.center B := by
    rw [EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere'.mp hA.mem_sphere, EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere'.mp hB.mem_sphere]
  have hc := EuclideanGeometry.side_side_side h1 rfl h2
  exact ⟨EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_of_congruent hc 0 1 2, EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_of_congruent hc 0 2 1⟩
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (Q A B : P), Q ≠ A → Q ≠ B → s.IsTangentAt A line[ℝ, Q, A] → s.IsTangentAt B line[ℝ, Q, B] → EuclideanGeometry.angle A Q s.center = EuclideanGeometry.angle B Q s.center ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle A s.center Q = EuclideanGeometry.angle B s.center Q
